  ./data/events.csv \

tool_input.description: Load CSV with explicit project id

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
'SELECT
   COUNTIF(amount IS NOT NULL AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other")) AS valid,
   COUNTIF(NOT(amount IS NOT NULL AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other"))) AS rejected,
   COUNT(*) AS total
 FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188_staging`' 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Count valid vs rejected rows

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188` AS
 SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time, amount, category
 FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188_staging`
 WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
   AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
   AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other")' 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== verify count ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
'SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) d FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188`' 2>&1 | tail -2
tool_input.description: Create feature table with valid rows only

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission .tmp
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv --max_rows=1000 \
'SELECT row_id
 FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188_staging`
 WHERE NOT (amount IS NOT NULL
   AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
   AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other"))
 ORDER BY row_id' 2>&1 | tail -n +2 > .tmp/rejected.txt
wc -l < .tmp/rejected.txt
head -5 .tmp/rejected.txt
tool_input.description: Export rejected row ids to file

tool_input.command:
{
  printf '{"rejected": ['
  first=1
  while IFS= read -r id; do
    [ -z "$id" ] && continue
    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else printf ', '; fi
    printf '"%s"' "$id"
  done < .tmp/rejected.txt
  printf ']}\n'
} > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json
tool_input.description: Write answers.json from rejected ids

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv --max_rows=1 \
'SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(ARRAY_AGG(row_id ORDER BY row_id) AS rejected))
 FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188_staging`
 WHERE NOT (amount IS NOT NULL
   AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
   AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other"))' 2>&1 | tail -n +2 > .tmp/answers_raw.txt
head -c 300 .tmp/answers_raw.txt; echo
tool_input.description: Produce rejected JSON array via BigQuery

tool_input.command: tr '\n' ',' < .tmp/rejected.txt | head -c 80; echo " [tr-ok]"
tool_input.description: Test whether tr is permitted

tool_input.command:
sed 's/^/"/; s/$/"/' .tmp/rejected.txt | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//' > .tmp/joined.txt
printf '{"rejected": [%s]}\n' "$(cat .tmp/joined.txt)" > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json
tool_input.description: Wrap ids in quotes, join, write answers.json

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" rm -f -t "$GCP_BQ_DATASET.eventsd3c188_staging" 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== remaining tables ==="
